name: delegance
description: See your business insurance in ChatGPT. Delegance Brokerage is a licensed insurance broker. Read your policies, renewal dates, quote status, and certificates of insurance, and ask for a certificate for a landlord or client.

interface.longDescription:
Delegance Brokerage is a licensed commercial insurance broker. Connect your Delegance account to see the business insurance we place and service for you, without leaving ChatGPT.

What you can do:
- Ask what a policy covers. Answers come from your own policy documents on file with Delegance.
- See your in-force policies, carriers, limits, and renewal dates.
- Check the status of a quote request.
- Create a certificate of insurance for a landlord, client, or general contractor.
- Open the Coverage sidebar or panel to see which risk areas have a policy on file, what your insurance costs, and quick actions such as a certificate or a quote.

Who it is for: business owners and their staff who hold a Delegance account.

Limits: Delegance shows only the company your account belongs to. Binding, changing, or paying for coverage happens with your Delegance broker or in the Delegance portal, not in ChatGPT. ChatGPT does not accept payment cards, bank details, or government identifiers such as SSNs or driver license numbers. Coverage answers describe your documents; your Delegance broker confirms anything that affects a claim or a contract.
defaultPrompt: What does my general liability cover?
Make a certificate for my landlord

positive.prompt: What policies do I have on file?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the demo company's in-force policies. Each one shows its line of coverage, carrier, and limits. Only the demo company's policies appear.

positive.prompt: When does my general liability policy renew?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the general liability policy's expiration date and the number of days until it renews, from the demo company's records.

positive.description: Certificate of insurance for a named holder
positive.prompt: Generate a certificate of insurance for Acme Corp at 123 Main St, Boston MA 02110.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates an ACORD 25 certificate PDF with Acme Corp, 123 Main St, Boston MA 02110 as the holder and returns an https download link. Only in-force policies appear on the certificate, and its valid-until date is not in the past. Nothing is emailed to the holder.

positive.description: Open the portal on the policies page
positive.prompt: Open the Delegance portal to my policies page.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a plain link to https://portal.delegancebrokerage.com/portal/policies. The link carries no sign-in credential. A signed-out user signs in with email and password and then lands on the policies page. The same link appears on web and mobile.

Opens the Delegance Coverage view beside the chat in three sections: Are you covered? (each risk area as Policy on file, Partly on file, or No policy on file), What it costs (annual premium and next payment due), and Quick actions. It never says a loss is covered. The sidebar entry opens it too.

negative.description: Personal auto insurance shopping, which Delegance does not offer
negative.prompt: What's the cheapest car insurance for my personal vehicle?

negative.description: General question about personal homeowners insurance, unrelated to the user's business account
negative.prompt: How do deductibles work on my homeowners insurance?

negative.description: Writing task that mentions insurance but needs no account data
negative.prompt: Write a cover letter for an insurance underwriter job.
